title: Address book
summary: A table of contacts, a list bound to it, and a form to add more.
done: Your address book keeps its contacts in a table, and the list shows them by itself. Added contacts stay on the phone, even after closing the app. Try [delete from … row …] when a contact is tapped.

welcome.text: A **table** keeps information in rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. We will make an address book with one.

add-table.text: Create a **table** with the **+** next to “Tables”, and call it “Contacts”.

columns.text: Rename the first column “Name” (click its title), then add a “Phone” column.

rows.text: Add two contacts with **Add a row**: type right into the cells.

bind.text: Select the **Data list** and, in **source (table)**, choose “Contacts”. The canvas shows your contacts at once.

add-block.text: Add [when {{Button}} is clicked] and, from the **Data** category, put [add a row to Contacts] inside.

fill.text: Plug [text of {{TextInput}}] into “Name” and [text of {{TextInput.2}}] into “Phone”.

run.text: In the preview, type a name and a number, then press **{{Button}}**: the contact shows up in the list.
